newsitem.title: USA: Denovo sees annual revenues of $17.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Denovo sees annual revenues of $17.2 mln.

text.p: DeNovo Corp said Wednesday it is forecasting $17.2 million in annual gross revenues with annual pre-tax earnings of $3 million.

DeNovo said additionally that it is changing its trading symbol temporarily to "DNVFC" because it is operating under an exception to the Nasdaq capital and surplus requirements and other criteria. The company said it plans to make a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission and Nasdaq by September 30 demonstrating compliance with all criteria.
DeNovo, through its subsidiaries Princeton Publishing and Firestone Publishing, publishes and distributes 21 magazines.
